summaries.zh: Functy fork of corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect. It reuses the WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI desktop sign-in and exposes those models in DSH chat. This line adds a sidebar credit card, a centre-column dashboard, a settings page, multi-account rotation (QR / token / desktop adopt), and a wider DSH peer range (`0.1.7-alpha.1` / `0.2.0-rc.1` / `0.2.0-rc.2`). Upstream npm `dsh-workbuddy-connect` remains a different package (0.7.1, DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 only).
